title: Supacheap.eu — Follow your first removal request
concept: One person (dummy data) starts the free five-broker test, sends the requests, and checks what is still pending. The payoff is a small, honest status change: request sent, with confirmed removal kept separate.
footnotes: REAL UI: supacheap.eu/en/free-tier, including the five named brokers and the real request form, filled with dummy data in a headless browser and never submitted.

PLACEHOLDER: the status/countdown dashboard is not public. Shot 4 follows the page's own description and must be replaced with a clean capture before render. "Request sent" is shown as pending; "Removal confirmed" stays a separate state at 0.
Brand note: supacheap.eu is a dark navy UI. The film frames it in the concept's off-white / slate / teal.
